meta.name: security-audit
meta.description: Deep security audit covering OWASP Top 10, authentication, authorization, data protection, dependency vulnerabilities, and secrets scanning. Delegates to the Centinela (QA) agent.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描代码中的安全漏洞与配置风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在发布前发现并修复安全漏洞。
copy.tagline_en: Scan code for security vulnerabilities and configuration risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find and fix security vulnerabilities before release.

howto.what: 会让 Claude 用 Centinela(QA)代理执行深度安全审计:跑 SIGN IN 清单、逐项查 OWASP Top 10、扫描硬编码密钥、审计依赖 CVE,最后给出 APPROVED 或 CHANGES REQUIRED 结论,并把报告写入 docs/reviews/。
howto.when: 发布前想确认安全状况时,涉及认证、授权或数据处理的重大改动后,或新增依赖与外部集成时,它会接管做审计。

say.note: 审计整个 src/,报告写入 docs/reviews/

howto.what_en: Runs a deep security audit via the Centinela (QA) agent: SIGN IN checklist, OWASP Top 10 checks, secrets scan, dependency CVE audit, then issues APPROVED or CHANGES REQUIRED and writes a report to docs/reviews/.
howto.when_en: Use it before a release, after significant changes touching authentication, authorization, or data handling, or when adding new dependencies and external integrations.
